svg.text: The trackball's own board talks PS/2 to the Pico; the MOSFET module switches its power off in sleep.
1. Unplug the trackball's USB cable from J1. 2. J1 DATA → GP2, CLOCK → GP3.
3. MOSFET OUT+ → J1 +5V and the ball light's yellow wire; OUT− → J1 GND and the black wire.
4. MOSFET TRIG → GP22, its GND → Pico GND (28). J1 M / R / L stay unconnected.

g.text: to the PC: USB-A to USB-A cable
3 lit buttons — 3-pin XH plug: latch toward you, wires down, pins 1-2-3 left to right
Waveshare 2.13" e-Paper HAT V4 — 8-pin JST lead
switches the trackball off in sleep
